# Pure Marketing

> Pure Marketing is a local lead generation and customer acquisition agency based in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada. We help Canadian local service businesses — contractors, electricians, plumbers, painters, roofers, HVAC companies, exterior/siding contractors, locksmiths, and general contractors — generate more qualified calls, estimates, and booked jobs through one coordinated system. No long-term contracts. Pricing is discussed privately after a free local growth assessment.

## Our One Service: The Local Lead Generation System

Pure Marketing has a single flagship service: [Local Lead Generation](https://puremarketing.ca/services/lead-generation). It combines four integrated capabilities into one coordinated system, not separate purchasable services:

1. Paid Customer Acquisition: Google Search Ads, Google Local Service Ads (where eligible), and Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Ads targeting customers actively searching for the client's service.
2. Google Maps & Local Search Visibility: Google Business Profile optimization, local SEO, and review strategy.
3. AI Search Discoverability: clear, structured, helpful content so the business is easier to find and recommend across traditional and AI-powered search.
4. Lead Capture & Conversion: high-converting forms, click-to-call, and tracking that turn inquiries into booked estimates and jobs.

Pure Marketing does not sell website design, social media management, video production, graphic design, or branding as standalone services. These capabilities may be used in support of the lead generation system (e.g. a landing page or video used as ad creative) but are never sold separately.

## Industries Served

- [Electricians](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/electricians): Local lead generation for electrical repairs, panel upgrades, and EV charger installations.
- [Plumbers](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/plumbers): Local lead generation for plumbing repairs, installations, and emergency service calls.
- [HVAC Companies](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/hvac): Local lead generation for heating and cooling companies, built around seasonal demand shifts.
- [Painters](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/painters): Local lead generation for interior/exterior painting estimates and seasonal project inquiries.
- [Roofing Companies](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/roofing): Local lead generation for re-roofs, repairs, and storm-damage estimate requests.
- [Exterior & Siding Contractors](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/exterior-services): Local lead generation for siding, soffit, fascia, and exterior renovation projects.
- [Locksmiths](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/locksmiths): Local lead generation for emergency lockout and locksmith services.
- [General Contractors](https://puremarketing.ca/industries/general-contractors): Local lead generation for residential and commercial renovation projects.

Pure Marketing does not currently take on restaurant or real estate agent clients.

## Service Areas

- Primary market: Hamilton, Ontario, Canada
- Greater Toronto Area: Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Burlington, Oakville
- Canada-wide: remote service available across Canada

## Key Facts

- Pure Marketing does not require long-term contracts. All engagements are month-to-month.
- Pure Marketing does not publish pricing, packages, or advertising-spend requirements publicly. Pricing and ad budget recommendations are discussed privately on a free local growth assessment call, based on the business's market and goals.
- A free local growth assessment reviews a business's current online visibility and identifies opportunities to generate more qualified calls, estimates, and inquiries. It is not a guarantee of a specific lead count, search ranking, or revenue outcome.
- Pure Marketing is a small, specialized agency focused exclusively on local service businesses in Canada.

## FAQ

Q: What is Pure Marketing?
A: Pure Marketing is a Hamilton, Ontario-based local lead generation and customer acquisition agency. It helps Canadian local service businesses generate more qualified calls, estimates, and job opportunities through one coordinated system combining paid advertising, Google Maps visibility, AI search discoverability, and lead capture and conversion.

Q: What does Pure Marketing's lead generation system include?
A: Paid customer acquisition (Google Search Ads, Google Local Service Ads, Meta Ads), Google Maps and local search visibility (Google Business Profile optimization and local SEO), AI search discoverability, and lead capture and conversion tracking. These are components of one system, not services sold individually.

Q: How much does Pure Marketing cost?
A: Pure Marketing does not publish pricing publicly. Ad spend and scope depend on the business's market and goals, and are discussed on a free local growth assessment call.

Q: Does Pure Marketing require contracts?
A: No. All engagements are month-to-month with no long-term contracts.

Q: Where is Pure Marketing located?
A: Hamilton, Ontario, Canada. Pure Marketing serves local service businesses across the Greater Toronto Area and Canada-wide.

Q: How do I get a free local growth assessment?
A: Submit the contact form at https://puremarketing.ca/contact, email info@puremarketing.ca, or call +1 647-951-2786. Office hours are Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 8 PM Eastern Time.

Q: What industries does Pure Marketing specialize in?
A: Local service businesses in the trades: electricians, plumbers, HVAC companies, painters, roofing companies, exterior and siding contractors, locksmiths, and general contractors. Pure Marketing does not currently serve restaurants or real estate agents.

Q: How quickly can Pure Marketing generate leads?
A: Timelines vary by market, competition, and starting point. Paid campaigns can go live within days; local search and AI discoverability improvements build over a longer period. Pure Marketing does not promise a fixed lead count or timeline.
